title: moogs_structures:conditional_concentric_rings
description: Concentric-rings placement whose ring count is chosen from (enabled_count, disabled_count) based on whether the (modid, vanilla_key) preset is enabled in ReplaceVanillaManager.

distance.description: Ring spacing in chunks. Must be in [0, 1023] or datapack load fails.

spread.description: Angular spread within a ring in chunks. Must be in [0, 1023] or datapack load fails.

preferred_biomes.description: Biome tag string (e.g. #minecraft:stronghold_biased_to) or a list of biome ids.

modid.description: Modid used to look up the preset in ReplaceVanillaManager.

vanilla_key.description: vanilla_key of a Replacement inside a preset owned by modid.

enabled_count.description: Ring count used when the preset is enabled. Must be in [1, 4095] or datapack load fails.

disabled_count.description: Ring count used when the preset is disabled. Must be in [0, 4095] or datapack load fails.

structure_id.description: Optional. If present, must resolve to a real structure in the pack.

locate_offset.description: Block offset [x, y, z] applied when locating this structure. Each component is clamped to [-16, 16]. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].

frequency.description: Probability (0.0-1.0) that a candidate chunk actually produces a structure.
